report:
**vendor-signup-390 (390px)**
- **Required-field asterisk color**: Asterisks on form labels (“EMAIL ADDRESS *”, “CURRENT SITUATION *”, “VENDOR NAME *”) and on the Partner Service Terms checkbox label render in the default dark text color in the preview. The design shows them in an orange/amber accent color.
- **Footer link vertical spacing**: Links under the Explore, Testing, and Legal columns are packed tighter in the preview (roughly 8 px effective gap) than in the design (roughly 16 px–20 px gap), making the footer noticeably denser.
- **CTA button copy**: The preview shows the long desktop label “Continue to Payment — $279/mo”. The mobile design specifies the shorter label “Continue — $279/mo”.
- **Vendor Name helper text**: The preview renders the desktop-length helper “How your business will be identified on the Finnrnick web site”. The mobile design calls for the shorter “Identified on the Finnrick website”.
- **Checkbox label whitespace**: The second checkbox label reads “Agree to thePartner Service Terms*” in the preview (missing space after “the”, asterisk directly attached). The design shows “Agree to the Partner Service Terms *”.

**vendor-signup-1440 (1440px)**
- **Required-field asterisk color**: Same issue as mobile—the asterisks on “EMAIL ADDRESS *”, “DO YOU DISTRIBUTE PEPTIDES COMMERCIALLY? *”, “CURRENT SITUATION *”, “VENDOR NAME *”, and the Partner Service Terms checkbox are dark in the preview instead of the design’s orange/amber.
- **Missing premium panel icon**: The design places a sparkle/upgrade icon to the left of the text “Upgrade to Premium for 10% off on Launch with Peptrace” inside the premium panel. The preview omits this icon entirely.
- **Batch-identifier pill width**: The three pills (“Yes, all products”, “Yes, some products”, “No”) stretch to fill the full width of the form column in the preview. In the design they remain compact, inline pills that do not grow to fill the container.
- **Footer link vertical spacing**: Footer anchor links have tighter line-height/gap in the preview than in the design, matching the spacing issue observed at 390 px.

**iPad-VendorSignUp (744px)**
